messages.text: Hello, did you have any discount Code

Hi there. We don't have any discount codes running right now, so prices on the site are what you pay.

I can see you've been looking at the Harlo B1 and the Thor P2. Those are very different machines. Are you after a small, quiet lottery miner for your desk, or more hashrate for the money? Tell me your budget and where it'll run, and I'll point you to the right one.
P2 is possible
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Thor P2

The Thor P2 is a solid pick. It's $385 right now, down from $449, and it's available to order.

It's quiet, about 40 dB. In Normal Mode it does about 6.6 to 6.8 TH/s on roughly 70 to 88 W. Switch to its Overclock Mode and it reaches about 10 TH/s at around 166 W. The power supply is included, and it connects over 2.4 GHz WiFi or ethernet. You'll get the plug for your country.

Here's the checkout link if you want it: https://heliumdeploy.myshopify.com/cart/48821748826367:1

Where would it be shipping to?
Germany
Used the order-swap skill

Thanks. For G., the Thor P2 isn't on the shelf in our EU warehouse today. It's a pre-order that ships by November 30, 2026, from our Netherlands warehouse.

Shipping from inside the EU means import VAT is included in the $385 and there's nothing more to pay on delivery. No customs, no duties. Shipping is calculated at checkout from your address. You'll get an EU plug.

Here's the link again if that date works for you: https://heliumdeploy.myshopify.com/cart/48821748826367:1

If you give me your budget and tell me how much noise and power is okay where it'll run, I'll find what's best value for you in Germany. I'll check what's in our EU warehouse and give you the real ship date for each one.

I understand. There are two cheaper options for Germany.

The Hammer Miner BC04 is $249 and does about 6 TH/s on roughly 100 W. It's in stock at our Netherlands warehouse and ships within 2 business days. It's a bit louder than the P2, at about 50 dB.

The Harlo B1 is $99. It does about 1.2 TH/s at 22 W in Normal mode, so it's a small, simple starter miner. It's a pre-order that ships by December 10, 2026.

Both ship from inside the EU, so VAT is included and there are no customs fees. Which one suits you better?
